description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers project-wide optimization sweeps that question the existing state (roadmaps, ADRs, decisions, structures) and end in new roadmaps. Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbors: /optimize (agent-layer tooling), /project-analyze (code/stack analysis), /project-health (read-only counts), /analyze:decision (single-decision audit), plain bug fixes.

queries.q: optimiere das Projekt basierend auf dem aktuellen Stand
what should we improve based on the current state of our roadmaps and decisions?
challenge our old decisions — are our ADRs still right?
hinterfrag unsere alten Entscheidungen und mach daraus eine neue Roadmap

analyze the project structure and create the missing context docs
